name: SqliteMcp
description: MCP server for SQLite database operations
long_description: MCP server for SQLite database operations. Enables AI agents and LLMs to interact with SQLite databases through a standardized MCP interface.

tools.name: db_info
tools.description: Get information about the SQLite database including path, existence, size, and table count

tools.name: list_tables
tools.description: List all user tables in the SQLite database (excludes system tables)

tools.name: get_table_schema
tools.description: Get the schema of a specified table in the SQLite database

tools.name: create_record
tools.description: Create a new record in the specified table with given column values

tools.name: read_records
tools.description: Read records from a table with optional conditions, limit, and offset

tools.name: update_records
tools.description: Update records in a table based on conditions with specified column values

tools.name: delete_records
tools.description: Delete records from a table based on conditions

tools.name: execute_query
tools.description: Execute a SQL query against the database with optional parameter values and return the results

SQLITE_DB_PATH.title: Sqlite Database Path
SQLITE_DB_PATH.description: Location of the sqlite database file with filename
